run.label: frames, and a remark the frames contradict

turns.text: There is no brush near the house. That is only mulch for the garden.

findings.instruction: Carry the stacked logs at least 30 feet from the walls to open ground.
findings.reason: The first frame shows an uncovered stack of logs piled directly against the house wall.

findings.instruction: Swap the 5 feet of fence next to the house for metal, brick or stone.
findings.reason: The third frame shows a wooden fence running right up to the house wall.

findings.instruction: Even for the garden, haul that dry mulch to the green waste bin.
findings.reason: The second frame shows tangled dead branches on the ground by the house, though you called it garden mulch.
